topic: The real Velociraptor was small and feathered
script: The real Velociraptor was about the size of a turkey. It was roughly 2 meters long, mostly tail, and weighed around 15 kilograms. Bumps on its arm bones show where feathers were attached. It had a large curved claw on each foot. Movie raptors are much closer in size to a bigger relative, Deinonychus. A famous 1971 fossil shows a Velociraptor locked in a fight with a Protoceratops.
